decisions.reason: Approved after actual comparison: recognizable yellow mascot with green eyes and closed neutral mouth, original bald crown with dark side hair and eyebrows retained, smooth upper lip/chin without invented facial hair or eyewear. Leftward head/gaze, tight bust crop, dark pinstriped suit, white shirt, dark tie and shaded photographic backing preserved. Broad short yellow head-to-collar transition seats naturally within the widened shirt collar, with coherent contact/shadow and no pale belly patch, floating collar, clipping or long yellow neck. No visible note-mark groups or source accessories lost. White/cyan views show solid dark jacket, shirt, tie, hair, body and backing. Actual master is RGB without an alpha channel; RGBA inspection consequently gives uniformly 255 (255,255), so no interior holes or alpha252/253 concern. Original has minor alpha246-255 variation but a solid rectangular photographic backing; complete opaque returned backing is visually faithful.
